Nevertheless, Nero goes to the hospital to convince Tara to resolve issues with Gemma, but Tara is enraged and tells him to worry about himself, as Gemma killed her previous husband. Also at the hospital, Gemma confronts Margaret Murphy, who accidentally confirms Gemma’s suspicion that Tara was never pregnant. Later in the day, Jax confronts Nero about visiting Tara, they get into a fight, and Gemma comes to break it up. She tells Jax what Margaret said and that Tara is filing for divorce. Jax, confused, traps Lowen in Unser’s RV and gets the truth out of her that Tara is planning on divorcing him and taking the kids away. Meanwhile, Nero confronts Gemma about what Tara said, and Gemma tells him the whole story, which she hadn’t told anyone before. The episode ends with Tara at home in a rocking chair singing to Thomas with a gun on her lap. Intertwined in this episode is also a story about a teenage girl who blames the Sons for the death of her mother, who is revealed to be the homeless woman Jax has been seeing around town for the last six years.

episodes.name: Huang Wu
episodes.overview: Jax looks to push the club forward, but the Irish put another obstacle in his way.
episodes.plot: Jax apologizes to Gemma and Nero for what happened with Tara after he discovered all the truth. After Clay locks down all of SAMCRO's gun customers, only one customer is left waiting to close on the deal, the Italian Cacuzza family. Jax and the Irish meet with Jimmy Cacuzza to ensure they're onboard with Clay's being the new distributor. In an attempt to secure the Italians as customers the Irish attack the Chinese (Lin), leaving SAMCRO in a very compromising position. After the meet, SAMCRO is kidnapped by the Chinese, who demand the Sons to hand over the business and territory, or else. The Chinese keep Happy as insurance that Jax will honor their demand. Tara catches Jax in bed with Collette and leaves angrily. Irate at everything that's gone on she decides to try to make a deal with DA Patterson but Patterson refuses, stating the deal is no longer on the table.

episodes.name: Aon Rud Persanta
episodes.overview: Tension mounts as the club makes a bold move to finally get out of guns.
episodes.plot: Clay gets broken out during his prison transfer, and Bobby gets shot in the process. Jax exacts his revenge on the Irish and Clay for past wrongdoings. Patterson is unhappy with the way Jax upheld his end of the deal and makes it seem as if she's going to throw that deal out. Tara contemplates making a deal of her own to stay out of jail, and get her and her sons out of Charming for good.

episodes.name: You Are My Sunshine
episodes.overview: As the dust beings to settle Jax’s world is suddenly turned upside down.
episodes.plot: As Jax reaches the verge of getting SAMCRO permanently out of the gun business, Tara makes a bold move in protecting her children. Juice's guilt leads Nero to the truth about Darvany's death. Mr. Wu's revenge on the Irish comes with unexpected consequences. After finding out the Sons are handing over the gun business to August Marks, Alvarez reaches out to Nero.

episodes.name: A Mother’s Work
episodes.overview: The ramifications of Jax’s choices put his club and family in jeopardy.
episodes.plot: Jax's search for Tara and his children leads him to make a difficult decision. Nero confronts Jax over Juice's role in Darvany's murder. Alvarez and Lin form a pact against the One Niners, which threatens to shut down SAMCRO's business in Stockton. Upon discovering, by Unser, that Tara has "made a deal", Gemma confronts Tara with violent results.

episodes.name: Black Widower
episodes.overview: In the wake of Tara’s death, Jax makes vengeance a club priority.
episodes.plot: In the wake of Tara's death, Jax makes vengeance a club priority. Meanwhile, Juice begins to hide from the club due to his actions.

episodes.name: Toil and Till
episodes.overview: SAMCRO solicits help from another Charter to get a messy job done.
episodes.plot: SAMCRO solicits help from another charter to get a messy job done. Also, Unser decides to investigate Tara's murder.

episodes.name: Playing with Monsters
episodes.overview: SAMCRO exploits an opportunity to secure an important alliance.
episodes.plot: SAMCRO exploits an opportunity to secure an important alliance. Juice reaches out to Chibs, only to learn his actions are beyond redemption.

episodes.name: Poor Little Lambs
episodes.overview: A past effort to help one ally leads to trouble with another.
episodes.plot: A past effort to help one ally leads to trouble with another. Also, retaliation from another club leads to deadly results.

episodes.name: Some Strange Eruption
episodes.overview: Looking for the source of a betrayal leads to violence at the Stockton Ports.
episodes.plot: Looking for the source of a betrayal leads to violence at the Stockton Ports. Meanwhile, Gemma decides to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.name: Smoke 'em if You Got 'em
episodes.overview: Jax settles a score by taking advantage of shifting alliances.
episodes.plot: Jax takes advantage of shifting alliances to protect the MC and settle a score. Also, Juice seeks help from an old rival MC with an agenda of their own.

episodes.name: Greensleeves
episodes.overview: SAMCRO forges an unlikely partnership in order to undermine a powerful enemy.
episodes.plot: In order to undermine a powerful club enemy, SAMCRO makes an uneasy alliance. Things take a turn for the worse when a core member of SAMCRO becomes the target of a new threat.

episodes.name: The Separation of Crows
episodes.overview: With the search for a missing member at a standstill, focus shifts to flushing out an internal rat.
episodes.plot: The club focuses on flushing out a rat with the search of a missing member at a standstill. Meanwhile, Jax has been hit with unexpected news regarding his father's death.

episodes.name: What a Piece of Work Is Man
episodes.overview: The club deals with heartache internally and conflict with the organization at large.
episodes.plot: The club deals with heartache internally and conflict with the organization at large. Meanwhile, Unser and Jarry get closer to the truth about Tara's murder.

episodes.name: Faith and Despondency
episodes.overview: SAMCRO members fall in love, but death is in the air.
episodes.plot: Love is in the air for SAMCRO members, but death wins the day. Abel causes circumstances that don't sit well with Jax and Gemma.

episodes.name: Suits of Woe
episodes.overview: The SOA organization bears down on SAMCRO and Jax comes face to face with an ugly truth.
episodes.plot: The SOA organization bears down on SAMCRO as Jax finally comes face to face with a heartbreaking truth regarding the death of Tara.

episodes.name: Red Rose
episodes.overview: With tensions mounting and truths finally revealed, Jax must make the ultimate decision.
episodes.plot: With tensions mounting and truths finally revealed, Jax must make his ultimate decision. Meanwhile, Gemma pays a visit to an old family member, and Juice decides his own fate.

episodes.name: Papa's Goods
episodes.overview: Ghosts loom large as Jax makes the final moves to fulfill his father's legacy.
episodes.plot: Ghosts loom large as Jax makes the final moves to fulfill his father's legacy. Also, Jax makes it his mission to eliminate loose ends, as SAMCRO finally abolish their "unwritten bylaw".
